checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: add an experimental Mental Rotation focus test after verifying spatial-training evidence and metadata

impact_assessment.why: Mental rotation was the remaining spatial candidate; Uttal 2013 found g=0.47 across 217 studies with transfer to untrained spatial tasks, while computerized math transfer is weaker
impact_assessment.benefits: A measured spatial-reasoning task with explicit claim boundaries; one new context record and v1.4 evidence table
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new mechanic across types/schema/UI/AI; default four-core lineup unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: additive adaptive level and snapshot support
impact_assessment.mitigation: engine/UI tests, fixed-clock before/after Menu/stage/results proof, ADR-048/R66 claim boundary, full gates
